decisions.review_note: Fixed synthetic operator adoption of bounded wording, not automatic semantic validation or scientific approval.

reviewed_claim.text: The 2020 record supports M under A, while the 2022 challenge concerns B and is not an A-to-A reversal. The 2023 review summarizes early evidence rather than independently corroborating it. In 2024, both challenging and supporting records use A: publication-record variation and same-year disagreement remain unresolved, with no latest-wins rule. Condition-specific assessment is required before transferring any justification.
reviewed_claim.uncertainty: Same recorded A is not sufficient scientific equivalence. Exact method/condition strings do not prove semantic comparability. Publication dates do not date decisions; personal beliefs and independent evidence counts remain unestablished.
